input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to the GWAS pair CSV (two rows, one per trait).
input.help_text: A comma-separated file with a header row and exactly two rows, one per trait: trait, sumstats, build, trait_type, sample size (n, or n_cases + n_controls, or n_col) and the column names in the sumstats file. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/sherlock/usage#samplesheet-input).

qtl_manifest.description: Path to the xQTL manifest CSV (one row per QTL dataset).

steps.description: Comma-separated list of steps to run, e.g. 'qc,rg,lrg,pleio'. QC always runs.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

ancestry.description: Population of both GWAS. The LD reference panel must match it.

ref_panel.description: PLINK prefix of the LD reference panel (path without .bed/.bim/.fam).

chain_file.description: UCSC liftover chain file. Only needed if a GWAS build differs from target_build.

hm3.description: HapMap3 SNP list (e.g. w_hm3.snplist) used by LDSC munge to keep and align SNPs.
hm3.help_text: Needed when the rg step runs. The standard file comes with the LDSC reference data.

ldsc_ref.description: LDSC LD score folder (e.g. eur_w_ld_chr/) with <chr>.l2.ldscore.gz files.
ldsc_ref.help_text: Needed when the rg step runs. Used for both LD scores and regression weights. Must match the ancestry of both GWAS.

hdl_ref.help_text: Needed when rg_methods includes 'hdl'. Download from https://github.com/zhenin/HDL/wiki/Reference-panels (UKB panels are EUR only; the array panel is ~7.5 GB, imputed HapMap3 ~33 GB).

hdll_ref.description: HDL-L reference folder holding LD.path/ and bim.path/.
hdll_ref.help_text: Needed when lrg_methods includes 'hdll'. Download LD.path.zip and bim.path.zip from https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.11001214 (~1.85 GB, UKB EUR) and unzip both into one folder.

lava_ref.description: LAVA LD reference folder holding <prefix>_chr*.bcor and <prefix>_chr*.info files.
lava_ref.help_text: Needed when lrg_methods includes 'lava'. Download the UK Biobank reference (lava-ukb-v1.1, GRCh37, ~14 GB zipped / 15 GB unzipped, EUR) from https://github.com/josefin-werme/LAVA/blob/main/REFERENCE.md and unzip all chromosome zips into one folder.

lava_loci.description: LAVA locus definition file (columns LOC CHR START STOP, optional SNPS).
lava_loci.help_text: Needed when lrg_methods includes 'lava'. Coordinates must be in the same build as lava_ref (GRCh37 for lava-ukb-v1.1), unless a SNPS column is given. The default LAVA file is support_data/blocks_s2500_m25_f1_w200.GRCh37_hg19.locfile in the LAVA repo.

conjfdr_ref.description: cfdr.pleio reference folder holding all_chr_perVariant.rds and chr01..22_LDpairs.rds.
conjfdr_ref.help_text: Needed when pleio_methods includes 'conjfdr'. Download genref.zip from https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5750318 (~3 GB, 1000 Genomes phase 3 EUR, GRCh37) and unzip it. SNPs are matched by rsID, so the GWAS build does not matter.

rg_options.title: Genetic correlation options
rg_options.description: Settings for the global rg step (LDSC + HDL).

rg_methods.description: Comma-separated rg methods to run, e.g. 'ldsc' or 'ldsc,hdl'.

rg_hdl_nref.description: Sample size of the HDL reference panel. Leave empty for the UKB panels (335265).

lrg_options.title: Local genetic correlation options
lrg_options.description: Settings for the local rg step (HDL-L, LAVA).

lrg_methods.description: Comma-separated local rg methods to run, e.g. 'hdll', 'lava' or 'hdll,lava'.

lrg_hdll_n0.description: Number of samples shared by the two GWAS. Leave empty for no overlap (0).
lrg_hdll_n0.help_text: Unlike global HDL, HDL-L does not estimate sample overlap itself. Set it if the two GWAS share cohorts (e.g. both include UK Biobank).

lrg_lava_univ_thresh.description: Local h2 p-value threshold for LAVA. Leave empty for the default (0.05).
lrg_lava_univ_thresh.help_text: LAVA only tests local rg at loci where both traits have local h2 p below this threshold. Per-pair FDR/Bonferroni columns are computed over those tested loci.

pleio_options.title: Pleiotropy options
pleio_options.description: Settings for the pleiotropy step (conjFDR). MHC and APOE exclusion follow qc_drop_mhc and qc_drop_apoe.

pleio_methods.description: Comma-separated pleiotropy methods to run. Only 'conjfdr' for now.

pleio_conjfdr_n_iter.description: Number of random LD-pruning iterations. Leave empty for the default (500).
pleio_conjfdr_n_iter.help_text: More iterations give more stable FDR values but need more memory (about SNPs x iterations x 4 bytes).

pleio_conjfdr_seed.description: Random seed for LD pruning. Leave empty for the default (154226).

pleio_conjfdr_maf_min.description: Minimum MAF in the reference panel. Leave empty for the default (0.005).

pleio_conjfdr_thresh.description: conjFDR threshold for the pass file. Leave empty for the default (0.05).
pleio_conjfdr_thresh.help_text: SNPs with conj_fdr below this value go to *.conjfdr.pass.tsv, which the loci step uses.

qc_options.title: QC options
qc_options.description: Settings for QC and liftover of the GWAS summary statistics.

target_build.description: Genome build that both GWAS are lifted to.

qc_maf_thresh.description: Remove SNPs with minor allele frequency below this value.

qc_info_thresh.description: Remove SNPs with imputation INFO below this value. Leave empty for no INFO filter.

qc_drop_indels.help_text: Switching this off can affect later steps (e.g. LDSC/HDL only use SNPs).

qc_drop_palindromes.help_text: Strand of palindromic SNPs can't be checked, so keeping them can give wrong allele directions in later steps.

qc_drop_multiallelic.description: Remove variants that share a position with another variant.

qc_drop_non_autosomal.help_text: LD references are autosomal, so X/Y variants are dropped later anyway.

qc_drop_mhc.help_text: Also excludes the MHC from conjFDR (chr6:25.1-33.9 Mb on the GRCh37 reference).

qc_drop_apoe.help_text: Also excludes APOE +-1 Mb from conjFDR (chr19 on the GRCh37 reference).

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
